humanStaging: Editorial human-scale analogy for information processing; does not assert human intervention in the runtime.
identity: Same adult operations planner: short curly dark hair, navy overshirt, mustard watch strap. Same daylight planning studio with a long walnut desk, cork wall, tall industrial windows and paper source archives. Colleague wears a light grey shirt.
sourceInvariants: Route resolution does not invoke a scenario.
No customer service is restored by this capability.
Only a decision or evidence becomes available.

shots.title: From uncertainty to a usable decision

input.information: supplied outcome, rule folio, frozen state report
input.tension: the colleague cannot tell which plan is usable
input.action: planner sits surrounded by several competing route sheets; colleague waits across the desk with empty hands
input.evidence: unsettled posture, competing maps, no chosen plan

event.action: both hands align working route sheets with the rule folio and state report, sliding incompatible working options aside while isolating one matching map
event.focus: comparison and deliberate separation, hands visibly in mid-action
event.causality: supplied requirements determine the isolated option

outcome.action: planner presents one clearly isolated map across the desk; colleague studies that map with focused understanding, competing working sheets remain aside
outcome.changedReality: an authorized continuation is now known
outcome.evidence: one usable decision, uncertainty resolved, original source folio remains on desk
outcome.boundary: neither person departs or executes the route

input.information: one outcome card with a distinctive angular outline and three distinct declared variant outlines
input.action: planner holds the outcome card at a distance from the three outline sheets spread across the desk
input.evidence: the relationship has not been established

event.action: planner slides a translucent working copy of the outcome outline onto the exact matching variant; the other two visibly mismatch
event.focus: two identical irregular silhouettes aligning in the hands
event.causality: exact correspondence rather than a default

outcome.action: the colleague holds the matched pair together against daylight; the planner has set the unmatched sheets separately aside
outcome.changedReality: the selected declared variant is known
outcome.evidence: matched silhouettes read as one coherent shape

input.information: variant card clipped to its supplied route folio
input.unresolved: which outgoing connection the folio declares
input.tension: the colleague waits for a usable route result
input.action: a folded folio obscures its internal connections; planner and colleague inspect it without a selected path
input.evidence: the route is not yet available to the observer

event.responsibility: resolve outgoing routes from supplied authority
event.action: planner unfolds the folio and lays a transparent working tracing along the one connection attached to the selected variant
event.focus: hands revealing and tracing the source-defined connection
event.causality: the supplied folio determines the path

outcome.action: colleague studies the isolated route tracing beside its open source folio; planner points to their correspondence
outcome.evidence: a readable isolated path and its still-visible source
outcome.boundary: nobody travels the route or operates equipment

shots.title: A trustworthy view of the supplied state

input.information: request envelope with a state report and matching authority seal
input.unresolved: whether the supplied record belongs with this request
input.tension: a loose bundle whose identity is not yet established
input.action: planner holds an opened envelope with its intact pages loosely spread on the desk
input.evidence: records and identity are not yet visually bound

event.responsibility: bind supplied state to governing identity
event.action: planner aligns the report's distinctive embossed identity seal against the matching folio seal and slides the unchanged report into a transparent protective sleeve
event.focus: matching seals and unaltered page entering the sleeve
event.causality: identity match establishes a bounded immutable snapshot

outcome.action: colleague holds the protected report and compares its visible seal with the source folio; the original envelope remains beside it
outcome.changedReality: a supplied immutable snapshot can now be inspected as a bound record
outcome.evidence: clear protective sleeve with original pages visible and matching identity
outcome.boundary: no page values are edited and no ambient archive is consulted

input.information: a folio showing three distinctly shaped required evidence slots; only two matching evidence pieces exist
input.unresolved: whether the proposed set is complete
input.tension: the colleague expects a complete decision packet
input.action: planner faces two evidence pieces on loose papers and a closed three-slot folio; colleague waits with an empty document carrier

event.action: planner opens the three-slot folio and places exactly two working evidence pieces in their matching slots; fingers pause at the obviously empty third shaped recess
event.focus: two occupied recesses and one unmistakably empty recess
event.causality: comparison exposes a member missing from the required set

outcome.action: planner tilts the still-incomplete open folio toward the colleague; colleague lowers the empty document carrier and points to the missing recess in recognition
outcome.evidence: missing recess remains clearly empty; both people attend to it
outcome.boundary: no member is executed and the physical staging is only an analogy

input.information: three required product silhouettes and a snapshot supplying two products
input.tension: a joined evidence packet is expected but not established
input.action: colleague waits with open hands while planner spreads the supplied product evidence beside a folded joining folio
input.evidence: unresolved readiness and an expected combined packet

event.action: planner opens a three-recess joining folio and fits the two existing working copies into two recesses; the third recess is visibly empty and the joining flap cannot cover a complete set
event.focus: hands checking the conspicuous empty recess, no new piece arrives
event.causality: one missing required product determines pending

outcome.camera: medium reverse shot with different blocking
outcome.action: the open incomplete folio rests between them; colleague has lowered expectant hands and leans in to the empty recess the planner indicates, understanding the unresolved requirement
outcome.changedReality: the reason for pending is now known; readiness itself remains unachieved
outcome.evidence: the same empty recess visible in a settled diagnostic conversation
outcome.boundary: no missing product arrives, no join executes, no green success cue

input.information: a small rigid authority card with exactly four circular permitted-use recesses; all four are already occupied by dark used tokens
input.unresolved: whether a proposed return is allowed
input.tension: the colleague presents another proposed route sheet
input.action: the same WOMAN planner with short dark curls and navy shirt sits before a closed small authority case; her grey-shirted colleague offers one extra light-colored request token on a separate paper
input.evidence: a proposed next return has no decision yet

event.responsibility: compare recorded iterations with declared bound
event.action: the WOMAN opens the small rigid authority case: EXACTLY FOUR circular recesses exist, and ALL FOUR are occupied by dark used tokens. Her open palm holds the extra light request token beside the FULL case. There are NO empty recesses, no paper ledger and no writing
event.focus: four out of four slots full, extra token visibly cannot fit; unchanged bound is finite and unmistakable
event.causality: the supplied exhausted bound excludes the proposal

outcome.action: the same WOMAN returns the extra light token to the colleague with a gentle stop gesture; the four-slot case remains OPEN and FULL with the same four dark tokens. The colleague pulls back the extra request, understanding there is no capacity in the declared bound
outcome.changedReality: the lack of return authority is now known
outcome.evidence: full four-slot record and the separate unaccepted fifth token; no token was added or removed
outcome.boundary: no counter increments, no route is retried

shots.title: The decision travels with its reasons

input.information: separate membership, readiness and return reports bound to one identity
input.unresolved: one continuation has not yet been established
input.tension: fragmented evidence is difficult to use
input.action: the same WOMAN planner from the reference, with navy overshirt and short dark curls, faces three separate working evidence folios and an empty outer decision folder. One evidence folio has a large EMPTY triangular recess next to two occupied recesses. NO readable text on any paper
input.evidence: evidence exists but no unified conclusion is presented

event.action: the WOMAN places the three small evidence folios side by side inside one open outer decision folder, preserving the large EMPTY triangular recess fully visible in the center. Tabs physically connect each inner folio to its original source on the desk. NO printed words, no paragraphs
event.focus: three separate working folios being unified around a conspicuous empty triangular requirement; the empty space must be large and obvious
event.causality: the unresolved required product determines the pending continuation

outcome.action: the grey-shirted colleague holds the single OPEN assembled decision folder, with all three inner folios and the LARGE EMPTY TRIANGULAR RECESS facing the camera. He points to that missing requirement with an understanding but concerned expression. The same WOMAN stands beside him. The original source papers remain separate on the desk; no piece fills the hole
outcome.changedReality: one pending continuation and its reasons are now usable knowledge
outcome.evidence: one coherent folder instead of three separate reports, with the same empty triangular requirement plainly visible; no words or labels needed
outcome.boundary: no invocation begins and pending is not depicted as success
